text:
24-hour news summary.

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5377) Edison Scientific and FutureHouse introduced “Millennium Problems” for Biology: difficult challenges with straightforward laboratory validation that could advance biotechnology and disease treatment.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5378) An open-source “better Jev” decision model was announced.

3 JevBench results place Jev narrowly ahead of competing Jev-class models.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5380) A post highlights Jev’s ability to chat in addition to its other capabilities.

5 Nucleus Genomics announced Vitruvian genetic-optimization models that it claims can optimize embryo DNA for 14 IQ points.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5382) Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas argued that export controls could push China to become a stronger open-source AI competitor.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5383) StepFun introduced Step 5 Preview, a 600B-parameter MoE model for agentic work with a one-million-token context window and vision.

--Hermes
